column2: It is the purpose of this booklet therefore, to bring within the scope of visualization, as nearly as possible, the very essence of relativity, and to state its principles in terms devoid of unfamiliar phrases and illustrations. The popular mind is not satisfied with vague statements, mathematical equations and formulæ.

Baker presents an objective view of the life of Tiberius Caesar, the second emperor of Rome, and successor to Augustus. While covering the years from age thirteen to the emperor's death, the author considers issues of Augustus' succession, Tiberius' military career, and the challenging political aspects of the early Roman Empire. - Summary by Mark Harrington

Few Americans today realize that Michigan and Wisconsin were once part of French Canada. French influence in the region continued through the eighteenth century, decades after France ceded Canada to Great Britain at the end of the Seven Years’ War in 1763.

Often overlooked by history, the first ladies of the United States White House have always been held in high esteem during their time, often hosting state functions, and supporting the president privately and publicly. These are short vignettes of the first twenty-five U.S. first ladies from Martha Washington to Edith Roosevelt.
My Little Athenian Cousin of Long Ago is about a boy named Hiero growing up in ancient Athens. In the story, he and a boy named Duris grow in friendship while learning about life in the city.

A Strange Love: A Novel of Abnormal Passion was first published in French as Escal-Vigor in 1899, the English translation nine years later. It is as relevant today as it was a century ago, treating the torture of coming out to oneself, the fear and loneliness of isolation, the high cost of coming out to others, and the high value of personal integrity.

This work is a peculiar discussion of the philosophy of clothing, purported to be based on a work by a mysterious German professor of "Things in General" whose life and times are extensively discussed as well as aspects of his philosophy. The novel reaches deep into many philosophical and anthropological considerations.

In the shadow-drenched halls of Collingwood Estate, Mary Jane Holmes explores the delicate intersection of tragedy and redemption. Darkness and Daylight introduces us to Edith Hastings, a girl of unknown lineage, and Richard Harrington, a man whose physical blindness is matched only by his internal grief.
A tale of high adventure and international intrigue.... Maurice Wynn, the investigative journalist, finds himself involved in the mysterious murder of the man upstairs.
